summary: The dataset reveals a clear LONG bias with 51% overall wins, but success is highly conditional. The strongest LONG setups require both DI+ dominance (>45) and low DI- (<25) combined with positive-to-neutral sentiment, yielding 67-75% win rates. SHORT trades are consistently unprofitable at 40% win rate regardless of conditions. The DNE signal miss rate of 56.5% suggests the signal filter is too conservative; relaxing it slightly could capture more valid LONG opportunities, especially during moderate-trend, positive-sentiment environments where the data shows strong edge.
